selection: Ford–Brown–High–St. Mary’s source centerline loop, including New Romaine, Duffus and Grady, plus 45 m context. Whole intersecting building footprints retained.
transforms: Local equirectangular east/south/up; no rotation, square forcing or nonuniform alignment.
Road polygons: buffered OSM centerlines, estimated widths from lanes; not municipal pavement polygons.
Source footprint polygons preserved; wall and roof positions approximate; gabled roof style substituted for unhandled pitched styles.
Ontario Terrarium pixel-center bilinear decode in Web Mercator, resampled to <=6 m local grid; source remains ~8.3 m. Road meshes split at matching terrain triangles with 6 cm visual clearance.
Vertical origin subtracted uniformly; no scale or terrain flattening.

licenses.code: Block viewer and adapted facade planner

limitations: Geographic test scaffold, not a reconstruction from video.
Heights, pitched roofs, facade details and road widths mostly estimated. No surveyed-accuracy claim.
No automatic alignment to source camera poses or Gaussian scene coordinates.
The screenshot identifies the requested neighborhood, not a verified exact footage trajectory.
Municipal layers, Google imagery and raw footage are not redistributed.
